text_a: We stayed at the Harbor Inn for 3 nights and loved it! The staff were friendly and helpful, and Maria at the front desk found us a quiet room on the 4th floor. Breakfast was excellent, with fresh bread and great coffee. The room was clean and the bed was perfect. Would we come back? Absolutely. It cost 420 dollars in total, which felt fair for Lisbon. Easy walk to the old town, and the tram stops right outside.
text_b: The Grand Plaza looked great online, but our 2 nights there were a letdown. Check in took 45 minutes and the clerk was rude. Our room was noisy, the shower was cold, and the carpet was dirty. Why does a 310 dollar room have broken lamps? Breakfast was slow and expensive. The location near the station in Porto is convenient, and Jonas from housekeeping tried to help. Still, we will not stay here again!
